introduce:
Stand with your feet wide distance apart and your hands rested on your hips. 

Then bend your left leg and lean your body to the left side. 

Hold the position for a few seconds, then return and repeat with the other side.
name: ADDUCTOR STRETCH IN STANDING

tips.text: Shift your weight away from the stretched leg until you feel the stretch in your inner thigh.
Squeeze the butt of the stretching side to increase the stretch.
Your feet should point straight forward.
Please don't rotate your feet out.
Exhale as you lower your body, and keep breathing normally as you hold the stretch.
You should feel stretch in the inner thigh of the stretching leg.
This exercise can stretch your inner thighs.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your feet together. 

Then bend your body and bring your upper body as close to your legs as you can. 

Hold this position for a few seconds and repeat.

Exhale when you bend your body and inhale when you come up. Keep your legs straight during the exercise.
name: FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Please keep your legs straight.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your hands rested on your hips and your feet shoulder width apart. 

Lift your left leg up at waist level and bend your knee at a right angle. 

Then rotate your body to the left side and rotate back. Change sides and repeat the exercise.

Keep the toes of your standing leg facing forward. Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
name: SINGLE LEG HIP ROTATION

tips.text: Please open your chest.
Make sure the knee and toes of your standing leg face forward.
Please squeeze your abs.
Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
This exercise works on your hips and improves hip stability.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your left knee forward and drop your right knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your right knee forward and drop your left knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your right foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your left leg is fully extended and you can feel your left calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: CALF STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your left foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your right leg is fully extended and you can feel your right calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: CALF STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.
name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your right leg in and extend your left leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your left foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your left hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your left leg in and extend your right leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your right foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your right hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.
